comment: The frame's own views for its visual gate: the states a workshop attendee sees on day one (125: the right panel opens on load, so the third view hides it), at one fixed viewport. The gate captures these on Linux CI and compares them with scripts/frame-reference-frame at 2%; the masks cover only what changes on every run (the app's port inside the address field, the right panel's terminal text) and never a control. The ACRYL set in scripts/frame-reference is the design target, read with `--against acryl` and reported only.
